commit_message: Add error handling test for UI.renderResults
title: 🧪 [Add error handling test for UI.renderResults]
description:
🎯 **What:** Added a missing test for the `try-catch` block handling UI rendering errors during the `calculate` function execution.
📊 **Coverage:** The test mocks `UI.renderResults` to throw an error and asserts that `els.savedStatus` is updated correctly with the error message and the `bad` class.
✨ **Result:** Increased test coverage by validating the application initialization error handling flow.
